cp2:1.1: Punāparaṃ yadā homi brāhmaṇo Saṅkhasa' vhayo mahāsamuddaṃ taritukāmo upagacchāmi paṭṭanaṃ. || ||
cp2:2.1: Tattha' ddasāmi paṭipathe sayambhuṃ aparājitaṃ kantāra' ddhānapaṭipannaṃ tattāya kaṭhinabhūmiyā. || ||
cp2:3.1: Tam-ahaṃ paṭipathe disvā imam-atthaṃ vicintayiṃ: idaṃ khettaṃ anuppattaṃ puññakāmassa jantuno. || ||
cp2:4.1: Yathā pi kassako puriso khettaṃ disvā mahāgamaṃ tattha bījaṃ na ropeti na so dhaññena atthiko, || ||
cp2:5.1: Evam-evāhaṃ puññakāmo disvā khettavar' uttamaṃ yadi tattha kāraṃ na karomi nāhaṃ puññena atthiko. || ||
cp2:6.1: Yathā amacco muddikāmo rañño antepure jane na deti tesaṃ dhanadhaññaṃ muddito parihāyati, || ||
cp2:7.1: Evam-evāhaṃ puññakāmo vipulaṃ disvāna dakkhiṇaṃ yadi tassa dānaṃ na dadāmi parihāyissāmi puññato || ||
cp2:8.1: Evāhaṃ cintayitvāna orohitvā upāhanā tassa pādāni vanditvā adāsiṃ chatt' upāhanaṃ. || ||
cp2:9.1: Ten' evāhaṃ sataguṇato sukhumālo sukhedhito api ca dānaṃ paripūrento evaṃ tassa adās' ahan-ti. || ||
